value.summary: The change adds four model price entries to MODEL_PRICES and four tests covering default-model pricing, the new deep tier's cost, cache-rate charging, and argument ordering. The price values are data I cannot verify against an external source, but the test arithmetic checks out: the pinned cost for z-ai/glm-5.2 on 82,914 input / 842 output tokens is ~$0.00599 (within the asserted [0.005, 0.007] band), and the argument-order and cache-rate tests produce the expected inequality directions given the stated parameter order (model, input, cached, output). No bugs introduced.
